pricing.title: You can start for free.
pricing.intro: Creating a profile, matching and exchanging your first messages don’t need a subscription. Premium lets you continue conversations without a credit quota or advertising.
pricing.comparisonIntro: Monthly and annual have the same benefits. Pick the billing period that works for you.
pricing.notice: Premium is paid from the start of your subscription. The payment amount and date are shown before confirmation.

howItWorks.eyebrow: The same approach on every plan
howItWorks.title: What does extending a conversation mean?
howItWorks.intro: A credit lets you continue a match beyond the first 24 hours. You do not need one to make a match or start chatting.

meet.title: Match, then chat for 24 hours
meet.text: After two mutual likes, the conversation opens for 24 hours. You can get to know each other on Free or Premium.

choose.title: 24 hours to choose together
choose.text: Sending messages then pauses, while your conversation history stays readable. Each person privately decides whether to continue. A refusal or the lack of two agreements within the time limit ends the match.

continue.title: Two agreements to keep going
continue.text: The conversation reopens when you both agree. Each Free participant then uses one credit; a Premium participant uses none. Revealing photos remains a separate mutual decision.

credits.title: What’s a credit for?
credits.intro: One credit extends one conversation. Each person uses their own balance: one person’s subscription does not replace the other’s credit.

weekly.title: {freeCredits} free credits each week
weekly.text: Your free balance resets every Monday at 00:00 UTC. Unused free credits do not carry over to the following week.

video.title: Extra credits, if you want them
video.text: An optional video ad earns 1 credit. You can hold up to {advertisingStock} advertising credits. Unused advertising credits, including reserved credits, expire every Monday at 00:00 UTC and must then be earned again by watching videos.

limit.title: Extend up to {weeklyMaximum} conversations each week
limit.text: This limit applies to each Free participant, even if they have credits left. Premium removes the limit and uses no credits.

reservation.title: A credit spent only when you both continue
reservation.text: Your credit is reserved when you choose to continue. It is only spent after both people agree. If the other person declines or the time runs out, the reservation is released. A free-credit reservation may remain linked to the week you agreed, even if the conversation is confirmed after Monday.

credits.mutualNote: Premium never grants access to a conversation or photos without the other person’s agreement.

payment.title: When is the first payment due?
payment.text: The first payment is due when you subscribe. Monthly then renews each month; annual renews each year. The exact amount appears in the offers above and on the payment page before you confirm. In-app prices are set by the app’s store.

annual.title: Is the annual subscription paid monthly?
annual.text: No, the twelve months are paid in one go. A monthly equivalent or saving shown in the offers above compares website prices; it is not a monthly payment.

renewal.title: Can I stop the renewal?
renewal.text: You can cancel renewal through subscription management. Premium access remains valid until the end of the current period.

mixed.title: What if only one person has Premium?
mixed.text: You must still both agree to continue. The Premium participant uses no credits; the Free participant uses their own and remains limited to {weeklyMaximum} extended conversations each week.
